# 1. Loading R Package

```{r}
#| eval: false
remotes::install_github('uva-bi-sdad/catchment')
```

```{r}
pacman::p_load(sf, tidyverse, tmap, accessibility, catchment)
```

# 2. Importing geospatial data and preparation

```{r}
mpsz <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "MP14_SUBZONE_NO_SEA_PL") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
```

```{r}
hexagons <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "hexagons") %>% 
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
```

```{r}
eldercare <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "ELDERCARE") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 3414)
```

```{r}
eldercare <- eldercare %>%
  select(fid, ADDRESSPOS) %>%
  mutate(capacity = 100)

hexagons <- hexagons %>%
  select(fid) %>%
  mutate(demand = 100) %>%
  rename(id = fid)
```

```{r}
ODMatrix <- read_csv("data/aspatial/OD_Matrix.csv", skip = 0)
```

```{r}
ODMatrix_tidied <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  rename(from_id = origin_id,
         to_id = destination_id,
         dist = total_cost)
```

```{r}
distmat <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  spread(destination_id, total_cost)%>%
  select(c(-c('origin_id')))

distmat_km <- as.matrix(distmat/1000)
```

```{r}
mapex <- st_bbox(hexagons)
```

# 3. Minimum Travel Distance to Nearest Eldercare

```{r}
dist2closest <- cost_to_closest(
  travel_matrix = ODMatrix_tidied,
  land_use_data = hexagons,
  opportunity = "demand",
  travel_cost = "dist",
  n = 1,
  group_by = character(0),
  active = TRUE,
  fill_missing_ids = TRUE
)

hex_acc <- hexagons %>%
  left_join(dist2closest) %>%
  rename(dist2closest = dist)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
tm_shape(hex_acc,
         bbox = mapex) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "dist2closest",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("Accessibility to the closest eldercare") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

# 4. Two-Step Floating Catchment Area

```{r}
df_2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km, 
  max_cost = 5) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("2SFCA" = ".")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
hex_2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_2sfca)

tm_shape(hex_2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "2SFCA",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

# 5. Enhanced 2-Step Floating Catchment

```{r}
step_weights <- list(c(5, .01), c(4, .05), c(3, .1), c(2, .4), c(1, 1))

df_e2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = step_weights) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("E2SFCA" = ".")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
hex_E2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_e2sfca)

tm_shape(hex_E2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "E2SFCA",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("E2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

# 7. 3-Step Floating Catchment Area

```{r}

  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = step_weights,
  normalize_weight = TRUE) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("3SFCA" = ".")
```


# 8. Modified 2-Step Floating Catchment

```{r}
df_m2sfca <- catchment_ratio(
  consumers = hexagons$demand,
  providers = eldercare$capacity,
  cost = distmat_km,
  weight = step_weights,
  adjust_providers = function(w) w^2) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rename("M2SFCA" = ".")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
hex_M2SFCA <- bind_cols(hexagons, df_m2sfca)

tm_shape(hex_M2SFCA,
         bbox = mapex) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "M2SFCA",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 10,
                values = "-brewer.blues")) +
tm_shape(eldercare) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.3,
          fill = "red",
          col = "black") +
  tm_title("M2SFCA Accessibility measures") +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
  tm_compass(type="8star", size = 2) +
  tm_scalebar() +
  tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
```

# 9. Extras: Statistical Graphics

As mentioned in class, I wanted to see the difference between all the methods and used Hands-on Exercise 7's code here to compare.

```{r}
hex_all <- hexagons %>%
  mutate(`2SFCA`   = df_2sfca$`2SFCA`,
         `E2SFCA`  = df_e2sfca$E2SFCA,
         `KD2SFCA` = df_kd2sfca$KD2SFCA,
         `3SFCA`   = df_3sfca$`3SFCA`,
         `M2SFCA`  = df_m2sfca$M2SFCA) %>%
  st_join(mpsz %>% select(REGION_N),
          join = st_intersects,
          largest = TRUE)
```

```{r}
acc_long <- hex_all %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`2SFCA`, `E2SFCA`, `KD2SFCA`, `3SFCA`, `M2SFCA`),
               names_to = "method",
               values_to = "accessibility") %>%
  mutate(method = factor(method,
                         levels = c("2SFCA", "E2SFCA", "KD2SFCA", "3SFCA", "M2SFCA")))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10
ggplot(data = acc_long,
       aes(y = accessibility,
           x = REGION_N)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(stat = "summary",
             fun = "mean",
             colour = "red",
             size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
